name: Carr, Riggs & Ingram
flags: 29-year-old CPA firm, not an AI-native startup, but fits the roll-up thesis: took a Centerbridge Partners/Bessemer growth investment Nov 2024 and has executed 7+ acquisitions since, with a first-ever outside CEO installed June 2026.

prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.founder: Bill Carr (founder, now Chairman); Dee Burger (CEO, appointed June 2026)
prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.funding_detail: Strategic growth investment from Centerbridge Partners (lead) with Bessemer Venture Partners co-investing, announced Nov 18, 2024; deal amount undisclosed. FY23 net revenue was ~$455.4M.
prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.past_completed_deals: Active roll-up under new PE backing: CapinCrouse (Jan 2025, largest merger in CRI's 28-year history), Axley & Rode (Jun 2025), Williams Steinert Mask CPAs (Sep 2025), Abroms & Associates (late Oct 2025), Trace Advisory (became CRI Government Solutions), DMR CPAs (Fort Worth, CRI's 12th acquisition since the Nov 2024 investment), DK Partners (Dec 2025). Also operates a dedicated 'CRI M&A Advisors' subsidiary.
prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.open_role: No corp-dev roles found; hiring across Tax (46), CFO Hub (5), Capital Markets (2), Transaction Advisory Services (1), plus general audit/accounting roles (124+ total open positions) as of 2026-08-24

prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.funding_detail: $75-85M+ total raised across 7 rounds. Series A ~$20.5M (2021, led by Tiger Global); Series B $36.5M (July 2023) led by QED Investors, with Tresalia Capital, Amador Holdings, Tiger Global, NFX, ALLVP, Magma Partners, MAYA Capital, One Way Ventures returning. A July 2026 profile cites total raised as 'over $85M' from QED Investors, NFX, and others - exact date/name of latest round unclear from public sources.
prior_enrichment_2026_08_24.past_completed_deals: Acquired Merge Transportation (South Carolina-based intra-US 3PL, ~14 employees) - Nuvocargo's first acquisition, expanding into domestic freight brokerage. Also acquired Mentum (YC-backed AI agent startup for procurement/supply chain automation), announced late Oct 2025, folded into Nuvocargo's R&D/NuvoOS team.
